title: Persistent serverless foundation — architecture audit and infrastructure design (Neon/R2/Upstash/worker model)
objective: Audit the deployed serverless state problem (request A on instance A holding one in-memory CADDocument, request B on instance B holding another; cold instances starting empty; instance-local idempotency; payload-carried SAVE/OPEN) and design the correct persistent foundation within frozen Architecture v1.1: stateless Vercel application functions over authoritative Neon PostgreSQL + Cloudflare R2 with non-authoritative Upstash Redis coordination, plus a persistent CAD/BIM worker model and a dependency-ordered migration roadmap — documentation-only deliverables, zero code and zero protected-path changes.
acceptance_criteria: The audit covers the governance/spec authority set (AGENTS.md, AI_CONTINUATION.md, IMPLEMENTATION.md, architecture-lock, development-workflow, architect-return-protocol, the CAD roadmap) and the application surfaces (apps/web host wiring incl. the /api/cad route and both P016 server adapters, apps/electron host, app/src app-api/caddocument/persist/collab/recovery/jobs/modelstream/adapters cores).

The command flows NEW/LINE/UNDO/REDO/SELECTALL/SAVE/OPEN and the document session lifecycle are traced end-to-end (UI shell → transport → AppApiHandler → CADDocument → persistence) and every step's state placement is classified.

The production deployment's actual configuration is established from repository evidence (PR #133 / the deployment guide branch): Vercel project identity, routes, no-external-secrets production state, engine availability boundaries — no assumed infrastructure.

The state inventory classifies every identified state into the five categories (authoritative persistent / persistent artifacts / ephemeral coordination / presentation client / worker state), each with location, current store, identity, target store and migration owner; a machine-readable JSON companion is produced.

The persistence model defines the Neon schema (document registry, append-only version chain, idempotency/command records, jobs with claim leases), the R2 content-addressed namespace derived from the application identity model, the Redis key inventory with TTL/authority/failure/rebuild per key, and the transaction boundaries with optimistic concurrency and typed conflict behavior.

The worker model defines the durable claim-based job lifecycle, reuses the existing process-per-call engine worker protocol and revision-binding contract, and presents an evidence-based worker platform recommendation with a primary choice, an alternative and evaluated rejections.

The multi-instance divergence is specified as a falsifiable proof test (create layer on one handler instance → a second fresh instance creates an entity on that layer → both converge on the one authoritative document; concurrent commits resolve by CAS with a typed conflict) with the CI shape and the deployed equivalent.

The roadmap decomposes the implementation into dependency-ordered work items (INFRA-002..INFRA-007) each with scope, acceptance shape, non-goals and evidence expectations, and records the COMPAT-CAD-011 coordination decision.

The design stays within frozen Architecture v1.1: Construction Graph authority (LOCK-019), engine/adapter boundaries (LOCK-003/018), versioned authority (LOCK-005), epistemic honesty (LOCK-007), secret isolation (LOCK-010) are preserved; no protected path is modified; no ACR is required.
Security discipline: no credentials, tokens or environment secret values appear in any repository file, PR body, fixture or generated document.
non_goals: No implementation code changes — this is the audit/design work item (documentation-only diff).
No modification of frozen architecture-controlled artifacts or any protected path (no ACR).
No store provisioning, no Vercel environment wiring, no production deployment changes.
No interference with the parallel COMPAT-CAD-006 implementation (its branch, PR #139, scope or governance record is untouched).
No successor governance records are created here — the Architect releases them per the return protocol; this PR defines their scope in the roadmap document.
No self-approval or self-verification; the record stops at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING for independent Architect review.
risk_assumptions: The serverless state problem is a state-placement defect (the module-level handler singleton is the only holder of the live document), not a platform defect — Vercel stays the application platform on deployment evidence rather than ideology.

Production currently runs with no external secrets (PR #133 evidence), so the durable P016 layer is CI-proven but production-unwired; the design treats fail-closed honesty as a feature to preserve, not a defect to silently patch.

The P016Persist port family is the correct architectural precedent to extend (append serialization point, pure transitions, content-addressed blobs, cross-backend byte identity) rather than inventing a competing persistence style.

Neon PostgreSQL, Cloudflare R2 and Upstash Redis satisfy spec §6's authority split (PostgreSQL authoritative / object storage authoritative for artifacts / Redis never authoritative); the task-specified 'Upstash already integrated with the Vercel project' claim was not verifiable from repository evidence and is treated as a wiring step (INFRA-005/007), not an assumed capability.
The worker platform recommendation (Railway primary / Cloud Run alternative) is container- and protocol-neutral, so the choice is revisable on evidence without redesign.

The CAD roadmap's COMPAT-CAD-011 (durable SAVE/OPEN) is the CAD-side consumer of this foundation; sequencing INFRA-002..004 ahead of it avoids double-building document persistence — a coordination recommendation to the Architect, not a roadmap edit.
evidence_requirements: Revision-bound documentation deliverables (the seven files under docs/infrastructure/ and docs/work-items/).
Audit traceability: every load-bearing finding cites auditable repository locations (files/lines at the audited revision).

The pre-existing main governance defect (CAD-PARITY-020.json missing dependencies, 13 failing tests on clean main — documented in PR #133) is disclosed and NOT fixed here (Architect authority over a VERIFIED record).
Governance validation of this branch's own diff: check-protected passes (docs-only, non-protected paths); the record itself is born DRAFT and traverses legal transitions only.
No test/regression claims beyond honesty: documentation-only change; the app suites are untouched.

transitions.reason: The Product Owner issued the INFRA-001 specification directly (full task directive: hard constraints, audit scope, five-category state inventory, persistence/job/worker/request models, security and local-dev models, migration strategy, deliverables list, implementation strategy and final-report format). The specification is complete and eligible for assignment.

The task directive assigns z-ai-infra-agent as the Infrastructure Architect / Implementation Analyst for INFRA-001 with an explicit non-interference boundary against the parallel COMPAT-CAD-006 worker and an explicit stop gate at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING.
